chapter: Coming up: Indiana and William Paterson
title: Too intimidated to study with George Coleman
summary: Mabern told him to see Coleman, but he stayed away for a while because Coleman was physically and musically imposing.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: Well he told me to go see him. I never went to see him. I saw George play live and I was so scared of that man I didn’t want to be within five feet of him. I didn’t go actually see him until, if I’m not mistaken, it may have been after my senior year or maybe after my junior year, but it wasn’t right away.

Well you know, if you don’t know him, he’s first of all he’s physically imposing. He looks like an NFL linebacker. And musically he’s very imposing. He plays the keys off the saxophone and he’s doing things that you can’t imagine ever being able to do if you’re a young player sitting there listening to him. How is he switching keys? How is he playing so fast? How does he play ballads like that? You know, everything. It’s like I said yesterday, it’s like standing at the base of Mount Everest and looking up. It’s scary. I didn’t want to get too close to that.
